title: ECPO: Evidence-Coupled Policy Optimization for Verifier-Audited Candidate Ranking
abstract: arXiv:2605.21993v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Ranking systems used for decision support should expose evidence that can be audited independently of the model's ranking scores. We study a closed-roster setting in which a policy jointly emits a Top-$K$ ranking and candidate-linked, span-grounded evidence bundles. Evidence-Coupled Policy Optimization (ECPO) combines listwise utility, certificate validity, and an evidence-cycle reward that removes answer-bearing fields before deterministic recovery. On MAVEN-ERE and RAMS, ECPO improves verifier-audited traceability, rank-blind recovery, and human comparative support relative to matched controls in the tested provenance settings. The gains persist under held-out evaluators, other 8B/14B backbones, and a HotpotQA answer-ranking interface. Ordinary NDCG and runtime remain explicit trade-offs.

translated_title: ECPO：用于可验证审计候选排序的证据耦合策略优化
translated_abstract: 用于决策支持的排序系统应当提供可独立于模型排序分数进行审计的证据。我们研究了一种封闭名单设定，其中策略同时输出Top-K排序以及与候选相关联的、基于文本片段的证据包。证据耦合策略优化（ECPO）结合了列表级效用、证书有效性，以及一种证据循环奖励——该奖励在确定性恢复之前移除包含答案的字段。在MAVEN-ERE和RAMS数据集上，在所测试的溯源设置中，ECPO相比匹配的对照方法提升了验证者可审计的可追溯性、排序盲恢复能力以及人类对比支持度。这些增益在留出评估器、其他8B/14B骨干模型以及HotpotQA答案排序接口下依然保持。常规的NDCG指标和运行时间则仍是明确的权衡代价。
tldr: 提出证据耦合策略优化（ECPO），通过证据循环奖励将Top-K排序与基于片段的可审计证据耦合，显著提升验证者可审计的可追溯性，且增益在多个基准、骨干模型与评估器下均保持稳健。
en_tdlr: ECPO jointly optimizes Top-K ranking with span-grounded, auditable evidence through an evidence-cycle reward, achieving verifier-auditable traceability whose gains persist across benchmarks, backbones, and held-out evaluators.
